# Marshall Elliott

## Overview

- **Age:** About fifty years old in Volume 1; approximately sixty years old by the end of Volume 4.  <sub>[v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v2 c23 P28](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c25 P2](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive and married  <sub>[v2 c25 P27](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0027)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c23 P28](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c27 P2](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0002), [v2 c9 P12](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Marshall Elliott is a fine-looking, tall, and broad-shouldered man with a clean-shaven, strong chin, a Roman nose, and frank gray eyes. For fifteen years he wore his hair in an unkempt cascade down his back and a river of crinkly brown beard reaching to his knees as part of a political vow. After shaving his beard and cutting his hair, he retained his impressive, vigorous physique.

_Sources: [v2 c9 P13](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0013), [v2 c9 P14](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0014), [v2 c16 P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 c25 P32](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0032)_

## Personality

Marshall Elliott is an intense, fiery-tempered man known for his extreme stubbornness and fierce partisan loyalty. Despite his crusty demeanor and outbursts of anger, he possesses a witty, intelligent, and well-read mind, making him an engaging storyteller. He holds a deep chivalrous streak, firmly refusing to tolerate any derogatory remarks about women. Behind his stubborn eccentricities lies a kind, generous nature and an appreciation for spunk in others.

_Sources: [v2 c9 P14](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0014), [v2 c14 P43](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0043), [v2 c16 P28](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0028)_

## Goals

- To keep his vow until a Liberal government is elected in Canada  <sub>[v2 c9 P14](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0014), [v2 c25 P29](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0029)</sub>
- To marry Ellen West after years of separation  <sub>[v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), [v2 c27 P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007)</sub>

## History

Marshall Elliott grew up in Four Winds as a staunch Liberal. In his youth, he courted Ellen West, but the relationship ended in a bitter rift. During a heated general election fifteen years before the events of the Four Winds narrative, he publicly swore that he would not cut his hair or shave his beard until the Liberal party gained power. He adhered to this vow for a decade and a half, growing a massive mane and beard that made him an eccentric figure in the district. After the Liberals won the federal election, he immediately woke up the local barber in the middle of the night to shave his beard and trim his hair. Following his physical transformation, he renewed his courtship of Ellen West and persuaded her to marry him, ultimately moving to her farm to live together.

_Sources: [v2 c9 P14](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0014), [v2 c15 P29](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0029), [v2 c25 P6](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0006), [v2 c25 P29](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0029), [v2 c25 P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c27 P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007)_
